{{recipe|Brownies, Rich}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North American Cuisines]]

'''Rich brownies''' are cake-like but are denser and not springy or gooey.

== Ingredients ==
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) unsweetened [[Cookbook:Chocolate|baking chocolate]]
*⅔ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (160 g / 1.6 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dl]]) solid fat (e.g. [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]], [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]], or [[Cookbook:Lard|lard]])
*2 cups (450 g / 2.7 dl) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|baking sugar]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
*1¼ cup (300 g / 3 dl) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 cup (240 g / 2.4 dl) coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Nuts and seeds|nuts]] (½ inch / 1 cm [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]] work well)

== Procedure ==
#Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 175 °C (350 °F).
#Melt chocolate and margarine in a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]], or (carefully) in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] on low heat, stirring often.
#Remove from heat.
#Mix in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
#Excluding the nuts, mix the dry ingredients with each other, and then into the wet mixture.
#Mix in the nuts.
#Spread into a 30x20 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] (13x9 [[Cookbook:Inch|in]]) [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]], or into two 20x20 cm (8x8 in) baking pans.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 30 minutes, or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* This works well with 3 Tablespoons of oil in place of the solid fat. When using [[Cookbook:Lard|lard]], ⅓ cup should be about right.
* Unlike other brownie recipes which use [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]] and fill one small pan, this recipe uses baking chocolate and fills two small pans or one large one.
